metadata.purpose: Read-only comparison of pass-2 causal mechanisms with pre-run project records; not an audit gate, candidate disposition, severity assessment, confidence vote or promotion.

relation_definitions.exact_known: The same causal mechanism is explicitly recorded in a prior issue or precise prior raw/triage source. This says nothing about acceptance, validity, remediation or exploitability.
relation_definitions.related_distinct_extension: An earlier issue/policy/lead is related, but the candidate reaches a distinct remaining component, boundary, trigger, or bound that should not be folded into the prior disposition.
relation_definitions.new_to_register: No exact earlier causal mechanism identified after comparison with the supplied register and relevant linked reviews; retain as a separately registerable candidate subject to the independent judges.
relation_definitions.uncertain: The prior/current scope relationship cannot be resolved from the inspected record.

metadata.novelty_basis: relation compares against project records predating this rust-auditor run. A pass-1 repeat retains its prior project relation rather than becoming exact_known merely because this run already reported it. run_relation separately records within-run repetition.

rust_auditor_new_semantics.meaning: rust-auditor NEW denotes absence from the empty run-start local ledger, not absence from earlier project records. This artifact assigns no gate or ledger disposition.

search_for_new_key.result: No exact prior cause located. General RPC/pool-duty coverage is context, not a duplicate issue or accepted residual.

limitations: No builds, tests, runtime reproductions, executable PoCs, live RPC, network access, source edits, audit gate decisions or subagents were used. Only the requested /tmp JSON artifact was written.

rows.reason: The original report-5-math-core lead explicitly says the last burn leaves carry/carry_r at S=0 and the first post-deposit credit divides the old remainder among new shares. The exact older raw lead lacks an identified formal issue ID; generic historical dust bounds or owner acceptance are not imported.
